name: team_planning_split_scenario
description: Split a scenario of a Team Planning plan in two, so the part people agree on can stand alone. The changes event_ids names, and every earlier change to the same thing, move into a new scenario named name, which takes the scenario's place; the scenario keeps the rest, its id and what forks from it, and sits 'on' the new one over the same period. Every scenario resolves as before. Take event_ids as team_planning_split_needs lists them, the latest change to each subject and facet. Refused for an earlier change, which means the scenario changed since it was read, for the baseline, when nothing or everything would move, when a moving change needs something only a staying change creates (the refusal names those changes' event ids), or unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

event_ids.description: changes or pins in effect in the scenario

name.description: What the agreed part is, such as 'Agreed Q1 hires'. Don't put a person's name in it.
